population.span: In this randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled trial, 172 adults scheduled for on‐pump CABG received colchicine or placebo.

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was incidence of postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF).

estimate.span: Of 163 analyzed patients (81 colchicine, 82 placebo), POAF incidence was significantly lower in the colchicine group (17.3% vs. 46.3%; RR 0.37, 95% CI 0.21–0.66;

treatment_strategy.span: received colchicine or placebo. The regimen included a preoperative loading dose (1 mg twice daily) followed by a weight‐based maintenance dose (0.5 mg daily if <70 kg; 1 mg daily if ≥70 kg) for 14 days.

absent_reason.analysis_set: Sources report 163 analyzed patients out of 172 enrolled adults but do not identify the analysis as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or another defined analysis set.
absent_reason.follow_up: The endpoint assessment duration is not stated. The 14-day treatment regimen does not establish follow-up or an in-hospital/index-admission assessment window.

served_mismatch: The served RR and confidence interval match the reported POAF result. However, the served intention-to-treat designation and in-hospital/index-admission timepoint are unsupported by the held sources.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults scheduled for on-pump CABG fall within the question's adult cardiac-surgery population; ITT status remains unverified.

notes: The ft_42132185.txt source contains abstract and metadata only, with an explicit notice that full-text XML downloading is not allowed. BOUND applies to the four required fields and does not validate the served analysis-set or timepoint labels.
